name: Utility Business Alliance Public Company Limited
summary: Headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand, Utility Business Alliance Public Company Limited, established in 2000, offers comprehensive integrated operation and maintenance services tailored for the integrated water management sector across Thailand. These services encompass initial system startup and commissioning, ongoing operation and water resource management, routine maintenance, and effective troubleshooting. Additionally, the company provides design and consulting, procurement and installation, and construction solutions.
